title: CONNECT-IP HTTP/1.1 Upgrade Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9484 HTTP/1.1 CONNECT-IP upgrade request and response policy.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectIpHttp11UpgradePolicy` builds and validates HTTP/1.1 CONNECT-IP upgrade request/response fields: GET, single Host, Connection: Upgrade, Upgrade: connect-ip, malformed 400 recommendation, 101 Switching Protocols, response upgrade fields, no message content, Capsule Protocol start requirements, and failed-attempt connection close decision.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper is header/status policy only. It does not own TCP connection state or start a live Capsule stream.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Connection upgrade tokens are compared case-insensitively.
Request and response content is rejected.
Duplicate response Upgrade fields are rejected where the RFC requires a single field.
risks: Live HTTP/1.1 connection upgrade handling remains adapter work.
HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 Extended CONNECT policy remains a separate slice.
